title: The Rival Hunter
text: Another hunter, alone, after the same quarry, and far better equipped than you: a bow of black horn, a coat of scales, a pack of trophies. They suggest working together for an even split. Their hand never strays far from the bow.

options.label: Hunt together, for an even split, and keep an eye on that bow.

outcomes.text: They are as good as they look, and they guard your flank.
At the end they take the trophy and run, and you never saw the bow come up.

options.label: The quickest races them to the quarry, to take the kill for the House.

outcomes.text: You get there first, and they arrive in time to watch.

options.label: Rob them of their fine gear. A lone hunter out here will not be missed.

outcomes.text: Very good gear. They will not be needing it, and you do not look back.
